audience: support teams who answer customers in the Enchant help desk

useCases.title: Find open or unassigned tickets
useCases.text: Lists tickets, newest first, filtered by state or assignee. Unassigned tickets can be selected too. Each result has a short summary.

useCases.title: Read the conversation on a ticket
useCases.text: Opens a ticket with its messages, which are replies and notes, and can add the customer, assignee, inbox and labels, so you can summarize it.

useCases.title: Reply to a customer or add an internal note
useCases.text: Sends a reply by email to the customer on a ticket, or adds an internal note that the customer does not see.

useCases.title: Change a ticket's state, assignee, inbox or labels
useCases.text: Sets a ticket to open, hold or closed, changes its assignee or inbox, and adds or removes labels without touching the other labels.

useCases.title: Create a ticket for a customer
useCases.text: Creates an email ticket for a customer, given by id or by contact email. A new customer is created if the email is not known. You can add the first message.

useCases.title: Find a customer, or add or update one
useCases.text: Finds a customer by email or other contact, creates a customer, changes a name or summary, or adds a contact.
